// @env node
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { register } from 'node:module'
import process from 'node:process'

async function main() {
  register('./deny-builtins.mjs', import.meta.url)
  await assert.rejects(import('node:process'), /核心入口不能加载 Node 内建模块/u)

  const core = await import('@argvia/core')
  assert.equal('runMain' in core, false)
  const command = core.defineCommand({
    options: {
      verbose: core.option.boolean({ flag: '--verbose-output' }),
      force: core.option.boolean({ default: false }),
      items: core.option.string({ flag: '--item', multiple: true }),
    },
    run: context => context.options,
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(command, { argv: [] }), {
    kind: 'executed',
    value: { verbose: undefined, force: false, items: [] },
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(command, { argv: ['--verbose-output', '--item=a', '--item=b'] }), {
    kind: 'executed',
    value: { verbose: true, force: false, items: ['a', 'b'] },
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(command, { argv: ['--verbose-output=false', '--force=true'] }), {
    kind: 'executed',
    value: { verbose: false, force: true, items: [] },
  })
  const help = await core.run(command, { argv: ['--help'] })
  assert.equal(help.kind, 'help')
  assert.match(help.text, /--verbose-output\[=true\|false\]/u)
  assert.match(help.text, /--force/u)
  const leaf = core.defineCommand({
    options: { items: core.option.string({ flag: '--item', multiple: true }) },
    passthrough: true,
    run: context => [context.options.items, context.passthrough],
  })
  const wrapper = core.defineCommand({ commands: { run: leaf }, defaultCommand: 'run' })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(wrapper, { argv: ['--', '--help', '', '--'] }), {
    kind: 'executed', value: [[], ['--help', '', '--']],
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(wrapper, { argv: ['--item=a', '--item=b', '--', 'tail'] }), {
    kind: 'executed', value: [['a', 'b'], ['tail']],
  })
  const requestedExit = core.exit(7)
  assert.equal(Object.isFrozen(requestedExit), true)
  const exitCommand = core.defineCommand({
    name: 'tool',
    commands: { launch: core.defineCommand({ run: async () => requestedExit }) },
    defaultCommand: 'launch',
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(exitCommand, { argv: [] }), {
    kind: 'exit', exitCode: 7, commandPath: ['tool', 'launch'],
  })
  for (const value of [7, { ...requestedExit }]) {
    assert.deepEqual(await core.run(core.defineCommand({ run: () => value }), { argv: [] }), {
      kind: 'executed', value,
    })
  }
  assert.throws(() => core.exit(256), RangeError)
  class ProjectError extends core.CommandError {}
  const expectedFailure = new ProjectError('项目配置无效', { exitCode: 2 })
  const failedCommand = core.defineCommand({
    name: 'tool',
    commands: { launch: core.defineCommand({ run: async () => { throw expectedFailure } }) },
    defaultCommand: 'launch',
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(failedCommand, { argv: [] }), {
    kind: 'failed', message: '项目配置无效', exitCode: 2, commandPath: ['tool', 'launch'],
  })
  const returnedFailure = await core.run(core.defineCommand({ run: () => expectedFailure }), { argv: [] })
  assert.equal(returnedFailure.kind, 'executed')
  assert.equal(returnedFailure.value, expectedFailure)
  const unexpectedFailure = new Error('意外异常')
  await assert.rejects(
    core.run(core.defineCommand({ run: () => { throw unexpectedFailure } }), { argv: [] }),
    error => error === unexpectedFailure,
  )
  assert.throws(() => new core.CommandError(' '), TypeError)
  assert.throws(() => new core.CommandError('项目无效', { exitCode: 0 }), RangeError)
  await assert.rejects(import('@argvia/core/dist/index.js'), { code: 'ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED' })
  await assert.rejects(import('@argvia/node'), { code: 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND' })
  process.stdout.write('核心入口消费通过\n')
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error)
  process.exitCode = 1
})
